summary_en: Full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised to 50 yen per share from 44 yen, with interim dividend unchanged at 22 yen and year-end dividend increased by 6 yen to 28 yen. The increase reflects upward revision of net profit attributable to parent company shareholders to 17.0 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
San ju San Financial Group revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, raising the full-year payout to 50 yen per share from the previously announced 44 yen per share. The interim dividend remains at 22 yen per share, while the year-end dividend is increased by 6 yen to 28 yen per share. This revision reflects substantial upward adjustments to the company's full-year earnings forecast, with net profit attributable to parent company shareholders now projected at 17.0 billion yen, up from the prior forecast of 15.0 billion yen.

The earnings revision was driven primarily by higher-than-expected funding profit at subsidiary San ju San Bank. The company's fundamental shareholder return policy maintains a stable base dividend of 18 yen per share while targeting a payout ratio of approximately 30% based on net income attributable to parent company shareholders, providing a framework for sustainable long-term dividends while strengthening internal reserves and shareholder equity.
